description: This file defines a helper object for converting between DataType objects and their protocol buffer representations in Spark SQL Connect. It includes methods for converting to and from Catalyst types, handling various data types, including complex types like arrays, structs, maps, and user-defined types.

methods.name: toCatalystType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType to a Catalyst DataType.

methods.name: toCatalystDecimalType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.Decimal to a Catalyst DecimalType.

methods.name: toCatalystStringType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.String to a Catalyst StringType.

methods.name: toCatalystYearMonthIntervalType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.YearMonthInterval to a Catalyst YearMonthIntervalType.

methods.name: toCatalystDayTimeIntervalType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.DayTimeInterval to a Catalyst DayTimeIntervalType.

methods.name: toCatalystArrayType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.Array to a Catalyst ArrayType.

methods.name: toCatalystStructType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.Struct to a Catalyst StructType.

methods.name: toCatalystMapType
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.Map to a Catalyst MapType.

methods.name: toCatalystUDT
methods.description: Converts a proto.DataType.UDT to a Catalyst UserDefinedType.

methods.name: toConnectProtoType
methods.description: Converts a Catalyst DataType to a proto.DataType.

methods.name: toConnectProtoTypeInternal
methods.description: Internal method for converting DataType to proto.DataType with options.
